verdict_reason: Alvarez_Data.dta (2040 trials, 17 subjects) holds angle, ExGuess, one_vs_four and tar_vs_dis; the audit script's paired t-test of distractor-centroid error vs guessing-phase chance reproduces t(16)=-9.59, p=4.9e-8, dz=-2.33, matching the table and the report.

data_files.notes: Stata file the audit script reads (osf.io/d5im2). 120 trials per subject (80 experimental, 40 guessing). 'angle' is the localization error in degrees, derived by the do-file from mouse and dot coordinates.
Per-subject raw trial files with headers v1..v19 only; Alvarez_1.txt opened (120 lines incl. header). Interpreting them needs 'merge and analyze.do' (posted, not read in full).
Stata do-file building the .dta from the txt files; downloaded, not read.

key_test.test: paired t-test, per-subject mean localization error (angle) on distractor-centroid trials, experimental vs guessing phase; dz = t/sqrt(n)

obstacles: Key DV 'angle' is precomputed in the .dta; rebuilding it from raw txt requires the Stata do-file (no Stata here)
Table p '1e-04' is a floor; exact p is 4.9e-8
R packages readstata13, doBy, lsr not installed; not run in R
